title: Claim ledger for one page
description: content-engine/claims/{slug}.json. Every externally verifiable statement that may appear in future content. A high-risk legal or regulatory claim requires authoritative sourcing before it may be published — enforced by validate-research.py, not left to convention.

source.description: A real, checkable reference. Never invent one; an absent source is recorded as source_type 'unverified'.

publishable.description: Whether the future writer may state this as fact. Never true without provenance adequate to the claim's risk level.

appears_in_existing_copy.description: True when this claim is already live. Being published is not evidence — several live claims here are unverified.

source_ids.description: Ids from content-engine/sources/registry.json. Claims cite; they never restate a citation.

claim_boundary.description: For PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: the narrowed statement the evidence actually reaches. This, not the original, is what a writer may use.

contradiction.description: For CONTRADICTED: what the source says instead, stated explicitly.

review_by.description: Date after which the evidence is stale and must be re-checked. Required once publishable.

research_locked.description: True once a human or research pass has curated this file. bootstrap-research.py refuses to overwrite it even with --force.
